text: MASS A three-dimensional space-occupying lesion. Example descriptor terms in this demo include circumscribed, indistinct, microlobulated, obscured, and spiculated.
CALCIFICATION A focal deposit of calcium seen on breast imaging. Demo descriptor terms include coarse, punctate, and amorphous.

ASSESSMENT CATEGORIES BI-RADS category 0 means incomplete and additional imaging evaluation is needed. BI-RADS category 1 means negative. BI-RADS category 2 means benign. BI-RADS category 3 means probably benign. BI-RADS category 4 means suspicious. BI-RADS category 5 means highly suggestive of malignancy. BI-RADS category 6 means known biopsy-proven malignancy.

This demonstration guidance is intentionally synthetic and is not a clinical guideline. It exists only to exercise retrieval and guard logic in a software smoke test. Additional imaging evaluation can be represented for incomplete assessments. Short-interval follow-up can be represented for probably benign assessments. Biopsy language can be represented for suspicious assessments. Routine screening can be represented for negative or benign assessments. Biopsy language can be represented for suspicious assessments and is not a substitute for clinical judgment. For BI-RADS category 4, biopsy should be considered. For BI-RADS category 5, biopsy is strongly advised. BI-RADS categories 1 and 2 use routine screening, and category 3 uses short-interval follow-up.
